title: Dead Mount Death Play
description: As a legendary hero nears victory against a necromancer known as The Corpse God, things take an unexpected turn with the dark sorcerer’s final gambit—reincarnation magic. This last-ditch effort catches the brave fighter off guard, and now he’s a boy named Polka Shinoyama in a whole new world! The showdown between good and evil just got epic.

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: A legendary necromancer known as the Corpse God is finally slain by a hero—only to wake up in the body of Polka Shinoyama, a newly assassinated boy in present-day Tokyo. Can the sorcerer survive in this strange new world?

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Polka scrambles to get his bearings while facing off against his would-be killer's colleagues. Is this the prelude to a new fight for survival or the start of an unlikely friendship?

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Polka is settling into his new life when a man arrives begging Misaki to save him from gangsters. Polka sends her with him, but the job isn't what it seems. Meanwhile, other factions in Shinjuku investigate Polka's role in the fire.

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Polka's recent activities have caught the eye of a police unit dedicated to hunting down the most bizarre and seemingly superhuman offenders. To a peace-seeking necromancer, these cops could be worse trouble than the criminals he's fallen in with!

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Just when he thought the cops were bad enough, Polka comes face to face with Lemmings, Shinjuku's most legendary criminal. Will Polka reveal his necromancy to save his new friends? And will his powers even be enough to save them if he does?

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Keeping his promise to a ghost, Polka returns to his family's mansion with Misaki in tow. Can the necromancer fool the people who know the real Polka best? And can he save them from an unknown threat without arousing their suspicions?

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: The Shinoyama family is out of danger, but the Corpse God still needs to explain himself to Polka's father, Rozan! How will the gruff tycoon react to his youngest son's fate? Meanwhile, an eccentric criminal stages a jailbreak.

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Polka is about to resume business as usual when he gets two unexpected houseguests: his niece Sayo and her bodyguard! Do the pair just need a place to crash, or is something more sinister at play? And Inspector Iwanome is still on Polka's track.

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Inspector Iwanome pressures Polka into reading his fortune. What does the inspector hope to gain, and what will he do when the reading dredges up secrets from his past? Meanwhile, the date of the Phantom Solitaire's "performance" is fast approaching.

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Solitaire fills the skies of Shinjuku with blimps—all marked with the emblem of the Corpse God's home country! What is a symbol from another world doing in modern Japan, and who will take the magician's bait?

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: While everyone scrambles to discover the secret of the emblem, Polka receives an unexpected visitor. The modern world's most dangerous individuals are starting to realize that the fortune teller is more than he appears.

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: As a string of criminals, cops, and assassins converge on his building, the Corpse God finally decides to take action. How far will the necromancer go to defend his new home? And what new attention will his actions draw in a world without magic?

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Polka's magical rampage has drawn even more unwanted attention to his new home. As if thrill-seeking magicians and underworld hitmen weren't bad enough, he now has a shrewd reporter to contend with.

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Fortune telling for a reporter is interrupted by a police raid on Polka's building, and the necromancer could find himself on the wrong end of a frame-up. Does he have a new enemy, or is he caught in the crossfire between underworld power brokers?

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: One group of police officers leave empty-handed, but Polka and co. can't rest easy just yet—Inspector Iwanome is back for answers. The duo who tried to frame them hasn't given up, either, and one is a face from Takumi's past.

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Misaki and Xiaoyu team up to take on Momoya. But are even the two of them together a match for this gangly member of the Agakura clan? Meanwhile, Iwanome gets a phone call from his past.

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: One Agakura assassin didn't go down easy, and now the head of the clan has come to settle the score. How will Xiaoyu cope with this face from his past? And how will Iwanome and Arase cope when the Fire-Breathing Bug crashes their interrogation?

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Iwanome unmasks the traitor in the Metropolitan Police, but subduing them won't be easy—and he isn't the only one out for payback. An enigmatic new arrival may make things unexpectedly personal for the Corpse God.

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: A surprise visit from an old friend prompts the Corpse God to rethink how he fits into his new world. His first step? An overdue confrontation with Xiaoyu. Meanwhile, Iwanome, Clarissa, and Solitaire pursue the same mystery in their own ways.

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: The mysterious Civil visits the Corpse God to have his fortune told, and the encounter surprises both of them. The necromancer draws a step closer to the traces of his old world, but are they friend or foe?

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: A fight between a Shinoyama enforcer and Civil's bodyguard brings an abrupt end to the mysterious visitor's interview with the Corpse God. But will he really leave in peace? Meanwhile, Solitaire's latest scheme causes a stir.

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Civil confronts Solitaire, hoping to provoke a confrontation with the Fire-Breathing Bug, but he may get his wish sooner than he planned. Meanwhile, the Corpse God plots a rescue mission.

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: The day of the showdown arrives. The Corpse God and friends prepare to rescue the real Polka while other forces maneuver in the shadows. But a surprise visit from the kidnapper himself takes events in a direction no one expected.

episodes_data.title: Dead Mount Death Play Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: The Corpse God prepares to sacrifice himself to stop Civil, but his new friends have other ideas. Rescuing Polka's soul and regaining any shot at a peace will take two lifetimes worth of connections.
